interactions.measurement: control callback to synchronous scene render completion; excludes browser paint

memory.note: WASM includes graph and brain state; do not add those again. Download report includes an on-demand GPU memory estimate.

gpu.note: GPU estimate: live attributes/indices, RGBA textures including mipmaps, and conservative color/depth framebuffers; excludes driver and browser compositor overhead.

note: Conservative app-owned estimate, not process RSS. Intentionally counts potentially overlapping WASM/backing storage, graph/backing storage and archive/backing storage twice; the full archive allowance includes per-chunk overhead. Uses full-run WASM high water plus live main/Worker heaps and renderer-owned GPU estimates. Browser compositor, executable code and driver overhead are excluded.
